english: I don’t know which way to turn

evidence: Ter. Hec. 4.1.1: periī! quid agam? quō mē vertam? (Lewis & Short s.v. vertō)

phrases.english: I don’t know which way to turn.

sources: Lewis & Short: verto
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 172.
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
